Polanek is the name of 25km<sup>2</sup> sized map included in CSLA Iron Curtain - Operations expansion pack. The map is based on an area in southern Moravia in and around the town of {{Link|https://goo.gl/maps/vdQ2vKg1WUbP33dSA|Ždánice}} to represent some more of the inland territory of Czechoslovakia.

While the map is freely accessible on Steam Workshop, the main cDLC is still required to run the map.
